name: closeSetup
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.close) d.close(); return !!d; })()

name: templateLink
js: GMMCShare.makeLink(GMMC.getMap()).then(r => { sessionStorage.setItem('templateLen', r.length); return [GMMC.getMap().lines.length, Object.keys(GMMC.getMap().stations).length, r.length, r.tooLong]; })

name: newScenario
js: (() => { document.getElementById('scNewBtn').click(); const i = document.getElementById('scNameInput'); i.value = '2031 plan'; document.getElementById('scFormOk').click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r([GMMCScenarios.list().map(s => s.name), GMMC.getMap().lines.length]), 400)); })()

name: edit
js: (() => { const m = GMMC.getMap(); GMMC.checkpoint(); const gone = m.lines.pop(); const f = m.lines[0]; f.freq = { peak: 3, offpeak: 7 }; const last = f.path[f.path.length - 1]; const base = m.stations[last]; m.stations.zz_new = { id: 'zz_new', name: 'Test Station', nameZh: '', x: base.x + 2, y: base.y + 2, label: 'auto', interchange: 'auto', kind: 'station' }; f.path.push('zz_new'); GMMC.changed(); sessionStorage.setItem('editedRoutes', m.lines.length); return [gone.name, f.name]; })()

name: compareOn
js: (() => { document.getElementById('scCompareBtn').click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r([GMMCScenarios.isComparing(), document.getElementById('scTagL').textContent, document.getElementById('scTagR').textContent, document.querySelectorAll('#scBase path').length > 0, document.getElementById('scClipHost').getAttribute('clip-path')]), 300)); })()

name: keyboard
js: (() => { const h = document.getElementById('scHandle'); h.focus(); const before = h.getAttribute('aria-valuenow'); for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) h.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowRight', bubbles: true })); const mid = h.getAttribute('aria-valuenow'); h.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowLeft', shiftKey: true, bubbles: true })); return [before, mid, h.getAttribute('aria-valuenow'), document.getElementById('scDivider').style.left]; })()

name: share
js: GMMCShare.share().then(r => { sessionStorage.setItem('link', document.getElementById('shLinkText').value); const d = document.getElementById('shDialog'); const res = [r.length, r.tooLong, document.getElementById('shLen').textContent, document.getElementById('shDlgMsg').textContent]; d.close(); return res; })

name: saveProject
js: (() => { const j = GMMC.projectJson(); sessionStorage.setItem('proj', j); const o = JSON.parse(j); return [o.scenarios.items.length, o.scenarios.items.map(i => i.name + ':' + i.map.lines.length), o.scenarios.active === GMMCScenarios.active()]; })()

name: persistOnReload
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.close) d.close(); return [GMMCScenarios.list().map(s => s.name), GMMC.getMap().lines.length]; })()

name: loadProject
js: (() => { localStorage.removeItem('gmmc.scenarios.v1'); const ok = GMMC.loadJson(sessionStorage.getItem('proj')); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r([ok, GMMCScenarios.list().map(s => s.name), GMMC.getMap().lines.length, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gmmc.scenarios.v1')).items.length]), 500)); })()

name: oldProject
js: (() => { const o = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('proj')); delete o.scenarios; const ok = GMMC.loadJson(JSON.stringify(o)); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r([ok, GMMCScenarios.list().map(s => s.name)]), 400)); })()

name: openSharedLink
js: (() => { history.replaceState(null, '', sessionStorage.getItem('link')); setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 50); return 'reloading with ' + sessionStorage.getItem('link').length + ' chars'; })()

name: sharedPrompt
js: (async () => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.close) d.close(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const o = document.getElementById('shOpenDialog'); return [!!o && o.open, o && o.querySelector('#shOpenInfo').textContent]; })()

name: acceptShared
js: (() => { document.getElementById('shOpenBtn').click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r([GMMCScenarios.list().map(s => s.name), GMMC.getMap().lines.length, Number(sessionStorage.getItem('editedRoutes')), location.hash === '', GMMC.getMap().stations.zz_new ? 'has new station' : 'no new station']), 800)); })()
